def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    if not np.any(valid_mask):
        return priorities
    ratios = bins[valid_mask] / item
    diff = np.abs(np.round(ratios) - ratios)
    priorities[valid_mask] = -diff
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    remaining_space = bins[valid_mask] - item
    # Priority is higher when remaining space is close to a multiple of item size
    # Use the absolute difference from the nearest multiple of item size
    normalized_remaining = remaining_space / item
    fractional_part = np.abs(normalized_remaining - np.round(normalized_remaining))
    priorities[valid_mask] = -fractional_part  # Higher priority for smaller fractional part
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    remaining_capacity = bins[valid_mask] - item
    # Avoid division by zero; use a small epsilon if remaining capacity is zero
    safe_remaining = np.where(remaining_capacity == 0, 1e-12, remaining_capacity)
    priorities[valid_mask] = -(item / safe_remaining)
    return priorities
